verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same layout. In both, the 'Shop the Archive' CTA spills past the right edge of the lime panel and almost touches the end of 'price'. The '48H ONLY' badge has shrunk to a squashed pink ellipse whose text can't be read and no longer stands out. The Voltstride box is shrunk down and jammed onto the left edge of the panel. B is very slightly better because its box lines up with the headline, while A's box sits low and its badge drops toward the bottom edge.
